Company profile

Visa Inc., trading under the ticker V, is a global leader in digital payments, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories. Rather than issuing cards or setting interest rates, the company operates the world’s largest retail electronic payments network, known as VisaNet, which authorizes, clears, and settles payment transactions securely and efficiently. 

The enterprise traces its origins to 1958, when Bank of America launched the BankAmericard program in California, which represented one of the first revolving credit card programs for the American middle class. In 1970, the participating banks took control of the program, forming National BankAmericard Inc., which was officially rebranded as Visa in 1976 to reflect its growing international scope and universal acceptance. Visa subsequently reorganized into a private, global membership corporation before completing one of the largest initial public offerings in United States history in 2008. Today, the company continues to drive financial commerce by providing advanced processing infrastructure, fraud-prevention analytics, and innovative digital payment solutions that connect billions of account holders with millions of merchants worldwide.
